releaseNotes: Fixes the remaining Text + Pen rounded status pill by targeting the actual np122-status element
Fixes fullscreen cleanup against the real implementation, which uses the body class np122-full rather than the browser Fullscreen API
In fullscreen, topbar, bottom navigation, Notes title/header, sidebar, metadata, toolbars, options, page controls and footer actions are hidden while the paper fills the viewport
Keeps the existing fullscreen top-right status/X bar from the base Notes implementation
No changes to the hardware-confirmed writing, colors, resize or autosave logic
